final:
def stamp(ts: int) -> str:
    """Format a Unix timestamp in seconds as HH:MM:SS (UTC, 24-hour)."""
    pre ts >= 0
    post out.char_count() == 8
    ex stamp(0) == "00:00:00"
    ex stamp(3661) == "01:01:01"
    ex stamp(86399) == "23:59:59"
    sec = ts % 86400
    h = sec // 3600
    m = (sec // 60) % 60
    s = sec % 60
    hh = f"0{h}" if h < 10 else str(h)
    mm = f"0{m}" if m < 10 else str(m)
    ss = f"0{s}" if s < 10 else str(s)
    return f"{hh}:{mm}:{ss}"
